newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Honko IPO seen priced at HK$1.0 per share - sources.
newsitem.headline: Honko IPO seen priced at HK$1.0 per share - sources.

text.p: Honko International Holdings Ltd is expected to price its issue of 67 million new shares, or 25 percent of expanded share capital, at HK$1.0 per share, representing a historical price to earnings multiple of 6.2 times, market sources said on Friday.
Sources said one warrant would be attached for every five shares subscribed and proceeds were earmarked for expansion of the company's production facilities.
The offer by the electronic components maker and distributor is expected to open from October 1 to 4 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on October 14, sources said.
Standard Chartered is the sponsor of the new issue and HSBC Investment is the principal underwriter, sources said.
